questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in the following sentence: By the time we arrived, the concert _____ for half an hour.
Which sentence correctly reports the statement: 'I am writing an email to my boss.'?
options: He said he is writing an email to his boss.
He said he was writing an email to his boss.
He said he would write an email to his boss.
He said he had written an email to his boss.
questions.answer: He said he was writing an email to his boss.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the conditional: If I _____ more time, I would learn that language.
Choose the correct reported speech form: 'If I find her address, I will call her.'
options: He said that if he found her address, he would call her.
He said that if he had found her address, he would call her.
He said that if he should find her address, he would call her.
He said that if he finds her address, he will call her.
questions.answer: He said that if he found her address, he would call her.

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: The report suggested that the company _____ more environmentally friendly measures.
Which of the following sentences correctly uses the passive voice? Choose the option that indicates the agent.
options: The window was broken by a stone.
The window was broken by the children.
The window was broken by a falling stone.
The window was broken by the children's throwing.
questions.answer: The window was broken by the children.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition to complete the phrase: 'It's not my cup of _____. I don't like that drink.'
Select the correct collocation: 'She gave a _____ presentation on climate change.'
Which of the following sentences correctly uses a discourse marker to express concession?
options: Although I was tired, I went for a run.
However, I was tired, I went for a run.
Whereas I was tired, I went for a run.
Despite I was tired, I went for a run.
questions.answer: Although I was tired, I went for a run.
